title: OverclusterDRG: a Deterministic, LP-Free Heuristic for Robust $k$-Center
abstract: arXiv:2611.18931v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The $k$-center problem is a fundamental formulation for metric clustering. However, its min-max objective is highly sensitive to outliers, motivating the Robust $k$-Center (R$k$C) formulation which permits excluding up to $z$ points as outliers.   Existing algorithms for R$k$C suffer from scalability issues: LP rounding relies on fractional relaxations that scale poorly, known combinatorial approximation algorithms are computationally expensive due to radius guessing, and scalable randomized heuristics require exponential trial multipliers to guarantee success.   We present OverclusterDRG, a deterministic, LP-free heuristic for R$k$C. The algorithm leverages the theoretical insight of farthest-point oversampling -- adding exactly $z$ extra candidates to the center set to absorb outliers -- followed by a forward-greedy initialization and a $1$-swap local search. translated_title: OverclusterDRG：一种用于鲁棒k-中心问题的确定性、无线性规划的启发式算法
translated_abstract: k-中心问题是度量聚类的一种基本形式。然而，其最小-最大目标对异常值高度敏感，这促使了鲁棒k-中心问题的提出，该问题允许将最多z个点作为异常值排除。现有的RkC算法存在可扩展性问题：线性规划舍入依赖于扩展性差的分数松弛，已知的组合近似算法由于需要进行半径猜测而计算成本高昂，而可扩展的随机启发式算法则需要指数级的试验乘数才能保证成功。我们提出了OverclusterDRG，一种确定性的、无线性规划的RkC启发式算法。该算法利用最远点过采样的理论洞察——向中心集合精确添加z个额外候选点以吸收异常值——随后进行前向贪心初始化和1-交换局部搜索。在真实世界数据集上的评估表明，OverclusterDRG取得了良好的效果。
tldr: 本文提出OverclusterDRG，一种确定性的无线性规划启发式算法，通过最远点过采样精确添加z个额外候选中心以吸收异常值，并结合贪心初始化与1-交换局部搜索，高效求解对异常值鲁棒的k-中心聚类问题。
en_tdlr: OverclusterDRG is a deterministic, LP-free heuristic for Robust k-Center that absorbs outliers by oversampling exactly z farthest-point candidate centers, followed by forward-greedy initialization and 1-swap local search, achieving scalable performance on real-world datasets.
